-- x.go --
package m

func F(ch chan int, v int) {
	for {
	L:
		for range []int{1} {
			break L
		}
		select {
		case x := <-ch:
			_ = x
		}
		switch interface{}(v).(type) {
		case int:
			break
		}
		for range []int{1} {
			break
		}
		if v > 0 {
			break
		}
	}
}
